audit.why: Lux is a fragile, immobile poke mage with one single-target root (Q, 10s flat cooldown) and no dash — Pyke's hook/E-stun all-in dominates once Q is baited or spent, matching the packet's 55.56% owner win rate and all-Pyke level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The field exists specifically to hold real cooldown numbers, and Lux's Q cooldown (flat 10s at all ranks) is the single most important number in this matchup — it is the window Pyke plays around.
audit.corrected: Stated Light Binding's 10s flat cooldown explicitly and tied it to the E stun-chain window.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged three unmentioned interactions: Light Binding can cancel Bone Skewer's channel, Prismatic Barrier absorbs the burst window, and Illumination's auto-reset is the real combo tell — none were in the text.
audit.why: Pyke's Q is an interruptible channel; Lux's Q root cancels it outright. Her W shield changes all-in math. Her passive auto-reset (not a spell cast) is the actual tell that she's about to burst, which matters because her spell animations are otherwise easy to read.
audit.corrected: Folded the channel-cancel and shield-absorption points into dosFull/breakdown edits below.
